decisions.reason: The cross-platform tutorial localization strategy is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, with no stale attributes requiring removal.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording the reusable-background and separately rendered text strategy. The source does not necessarily cancel remote delivery of tutorial media.
The size-optimization effect is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, and the general optimization goal remains valid.
The client describes an app-level tutorial asset strategy that is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, with no obsolete key requiring removal.
Separating translatable tutorial text from background assets does not necessarily change the independent requirement for correct right-to-left layout behavior.
The tutorial localization and asset strategy does not change Android OS compatibility, deprecated API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
The tutorial asset decision has no necessary effect on the requirement to remove unused Android permissions.
The tutorial localization strategy does not change iOS framework modernization or deprecated API refactoring requirements.
Rebuilding tutorial images and rendering text separately does not affect the requirement to provide an iOS Privacy Manifest.
The tutorial localization strategy has no necessary effect on iOS signing certificates or signing configuration.
